doctor_backend.gpu: one pinned server per physical GPU 0..4 (five_gpu.doctor_urls)

feedback.leakage_guard: No ground truth or outcome label in Doctor input; validate original Agent reply IDs; structured none-supported experience allowed

verification.short_circuit: Within each trajectory, decide after two agreeing outcomes (2 of K=3). Across trajectories, KEEP at the first trajectory reaching the target in at least 2/3 reruns.
verification.support_order: A deterministic uniform sample of at most five same-rubric trajectories, without replacement.
verification.target: Each member's own feedback behavioral locus and member-specific intervention; Stage-1 Applicable required, No Match proceeds to the next assigned trajectory.
verification.keep: KEEP immediately when any sampled applicable trajectory reaches the requested outcome change in at least 2/3 reruns; otherwise NOT_VALIDATED after at most five valid trajectories or candidate exhaustion.

notes.rounds: Maximum two Agent turns per branch, branching factor four, full tree; intervention reruns use the selected member instruction followed by one Doctor FINAL.
notes.budget: full_tree only; pruning / subsampling is not defined
notes.rubric: One rubric per trajectory or conservative same-reason reuse, separately within case and outcome stratum. Success: observed helpful behavior=2; level 0 removes only that behavior. Failure: observed problem/omission=0; level 2 corrects that same problem. Level 1 is explicitly partial.
notes.rubric.gold_answer_visible: Doctor feedback and the Rubric Generator never receive a gold field (the final decision plus the outcome can imply it)
notes.post_hoc_gates: Blind Luna evidence gate blocks invalid schema/leakage, answer presupposition, unsupported premises, unobservable anchors and unclear score boundaries. Source anchoring and pre-rerun instruction validity have separate records.
notes.intervention: Score 0 and 2 use the same pinned Agent role, information boundary and five-sentence limit. The selected level template and saved instruction enter the system message; the user supplies only visible question, options and prefix. Doctor and scorer receive no intervention instruction.
notes.reruns_per_intervention: K = continuations per intervention target; a rerun count, not a rubric count
notes.R_O: Target flips / K: Score-2 counts parsed success (1), Score-0 counts parsed failure (0). Unparsed FINAL (None) stays in the denominator but never counts as a flip (parsed_target_only_v1).
notes.selection: The threshold selection fields are unused by random5_witness_v1. KEEP uses the first sampled member passing the within-member 2-of-3 outcome rule; prompt search is disabled.
notes.scoring: State/rubric applicability is shared across source, witness and final scoring; response behavior and source anchoring stay separate. Score boundaries use semantic minimum contribution M and completion C, with exact response evidence.
notes.agent_reward: frozen 2026-10-07: outcome_only 1.0 / 0.0 (arm override), outcome + rubric arms 0.5 / 0.5; a rubric-only condition would be 0.0 / 1.0. Per node: w_outcome * mean(descendant outcomes) + w_rubric * R_A | r_a_weighting = equal: R_A = unweighted mean of level/2 over the applicable KEEP rubrics; verification is a gate only (R_O(R) is no longer a weight).
notes.prompt_update: Disabled: P0 is fixed for the complete run; no P1 generation, prompt comparison or prompt refinement.
notes.prompt_hashes: scripts/online_rl/run_tree.py refuses to launch when a prompt/template file differs from its sha256
notes.evaluation: The independent idle 622-case evaluator of the source setup is NOT launched for this run (SHERPA_IDLE_EVAL_PRIORITY_DIR unset); no evaluation data enters training.
notes.data: The pinned 120-case MedMCQA training file and its stored order are unchanged from the preceding max2 experiment; protected calibration cases remain excluded. Source data are not redistributed.
notes.schedule: 120 same ordered cases, five per batch on GPU0-4; GPU4 updates after batch; checkpoint every30 cases; no evaluation.
notes.arms: This standalone five-GPU configuration is the fixed-P0, 0.5 rubric plus 0.5 outcome experiment. Alternative reward arms require their own configuration and output identity.
notes.feedback: Same local Doctor after FINAL, all-reflection-claims generator audit retained. Missing evidence does not become an earlier request.
notes.model_roles: Generator: pinned Gemini 3.8 Flash. Participating Doctor and post-FINAL reflection: the same local Gemma3 12B. Rubric gate, intervention audit and response scorer use their separately pinned Luna settings. Prompt-refiner settings are inactive.
notes.luna_alignment: strict JSON-schema output; trivial canonicalisation; at most one repair request to the same Luna model with the same input; a second invalid output is an operational error (retried on resume), never mapped or filled in
notes.rubric_reuse: Same-reason REUSE versus NEW is decided within each case and outcome stratum. Every matched member retains its own selected turn and instruction. Up to five sampled members are tested under random5_witness_v1; each KEEP rubric is scored once per response.
notes.rubric.generation: Pinned Gemini 3.8 Flash, reasoning effort low, maximum 6144 output tokens, plain JSON generation (response_format=null) validated against the pinned local v2.3 schema.
notes.doctor_backend: Local Ollama Doctor protocol v2 with seeded calls, minimum two and maximum two Agent turns per branch.
notes.verification: Sample at most five same-rubric trajectories. Each gets up to three reruns with early 2-of-3 decision; KEEP at the first passing trajectory.
notes.output_root: New output root for the fresh full-bank-scoring run. Previous runs, banks, caches and checkpoints remain separate.
notes.doctor_opening: New five-GPU protocol: immutable runtime D1 per case/protocol, shared across saved checkpoints; no frozen VAL50 table dependency.
notes.agent_protocol: frozen 2026-10-07: independent pre-assessment followed by collaborator-conditioned response (src/online_rl/agent_protocol.py); Stage A blind to the dialogue, Stage B sees its own Stage-A assessment as hidden context; joint two-stage GRPO action; shared by every reward arm; Agent prompt prompts/agent.txt and decoding unchanged
notes.feedback_locus: The participating Doctor supplies post-FINAL helpful and unresolved reflection items with original Agent reply IDs. The generator audits all claims and selects its source turn from the transcript.
notes.prompt_search_J: Inactive: P0 stays fixed for all 120 cases; there is no P1 generation, paired prompt comparison or prompt fitness calculation.
notes.rubric_source_consistency: Joint generation selects its source Agent turn using the complete transcript. Source applicability uses only the selected pre-reply state, and independent source behavior scoring remains separate. A failed source check rejects the candidate without rewriting its conditions.
notes.batch: Five cases per batch on GPU0..4, with Agent4 / Doctor1 capacity. GPU4 updates after the batch barrier and actors reload before the next batch. Save initial, every-30-case and final-120-case checkpoints; evaluation is disabled.
notes.doctor_final: FINAL outputs only Final answer: option <label>, no explanation or answer text, max32 tokens; discussion/hidden STATUS retain their existing budget and schema.
notes.prompt_update_evidence: Inactive because prompt_update.enabled=false; no diagnostic prompt-search reflection or refiner requests are executed.
notes.prompt_update_schema_guard: Inactive in this fixed-P0 experiment; generated rubrics still require the pinned local v2.3 schema.
notes.prompt_update_reuse_guard: Inactive in this fixed-P0 experiment; the existing six-check rubric reuse contract remains in force.
notes.prompt_update.refiner_guard: Inactive: no prompt-refiner output is generated or adopted.
notes.rubric_generation: Pinned trajectory_rubric_generator_v2_3_intervention_alignment joint generator with local schema validation, complete reflection-claim audit, explicit M/C definitions and written-instruction evidence. An independent instruction audit checks each selected member before reruns.
notes.scorer: Explicit response_evidence_v1 scorer with independently validated literal evidence for each response. Four sibling responses per request. UNSCORABLE is distinct from zero, nonapplicability and operational failure.
notes.grpo_sampling: Use raw policy sampling (temperature 1, top_p 1, top_k 0) so sampled actions and stored raw policy log probabilities match the GRPO importance-ratio distribution. This guard is specific to this new training configuration.
notes.run: Offline audit fixes v2.3: same 120-case order, max2 turns, fixed P0, fresh seeded base+LoRA and isolated output. No old rollout, rubric, applicability, gate, rerun or score cache imported.
notes.rollout_reuse: Disabled: fresh output and full protocol identity, with no frozen protocol override or imported cache.
notes.gate: Blind evidence gate v2 with versioned v2.2 prompt; a separate intervention_instruction_audit_v1 checks each selected member guide before reruns using only its pre-reply context, rubric and instruction.
notes.gate_activation: A separate output directory is required. Do not reuse legacy gate decisions, verified banks or final scores as v2 evidence. This config does not modify a running process. Validate any cache-only transition before launch and retain its source-policy and protocol provenance.
notes.feedback_grounding: Earlier explicit unresolved requests can remain active without re-asking. Review helpful repetition separately from first introduction. Exact claim evidence remains required; local validation alone does not establish semantic truth.
notes.activation: Fresh base Qwen3-8B and new untrained LoRA, empty cumulative bank, case cursor zero. No checkpoint handoff or prior bank/cache import.
notes.gate_quotes: Literal rubric quotation fields select an exact full visible field through the per-call schema enum. Quality checks, independent source score and exact evidence validation remain mandatory. Malformed output is an operational error, never a negative rubric or zero reward.
notes.instruction_alignment: Generation records explicit M, M+C and an exact guide quote. Independent instruction audit rejects guide/target mismatch, unsupported domain or contextual premises, and prescribed conclusions. Generated-reply adherence remains diagnostic; no adherence threshold or new reward affects KEEP.
notes.cumulative_scoring: After all five cases finish generation and verification, freeze one cumulative bank and check every criterion for each shared pre-response state. Only applicable criteria receive behavior scores; NA is not zero. No top-k cutoff in final scoring.
notes.cumulative_reuse: retrieval_top_k=8 applies only to the separate pre-generation reuse search; unchanged verified criteria are reused without new generation, Gate or witness reruns.
notes.restart: Fresh local Qwen3-8B base plus empty cumulative KEEP bank and new rollout; no prior adapter, rollout, bank, score cache or checkpoint import.
notes.pilot: Run once with --max-batches 1 to commit exactly five cases, then inspect the committed recovery checkpoint before resuming the same 120-case config. Do not change schedule.cases between pilot and continuation.
notes.rubric_scope: New base adapter and initially empty cumulative bank. Generate per eligible trajectory without pre-generation semantic matching, deduplicate only exact public criterion content within the source case and outcome stratum, run the existing random-5 witness, add KEEP criteria to the cumulative bank, then score each case against the same full bank frozen for its five-case batch.
notes.provider: All remote rubric-generation and judgment roles use the direct OpenAI gpt-6-luna provider. Prompt evolution is disabled; the configured reflection/refiner model IDs are pinned but unused. The exact-only assignment bypasses semantic matching/consolidation; no automatic semantic merge is enabled.
notes.gate_output_fix: Fresh first-five run after the v9 Gate quality calls on all five cases hit the 3072-token completion limit. Only the Gate output ceiling changes. Failed v9 output is retained as an incomplete separate run.
notes.start: Fresh Qwen3-8B base, fresh LoRA, empty rubric bank, and no inherited score cache or KEEP evidence.
notes.training: Pinned 120-case order, five cases per update, maximum four Agent turns.
notes.quality_contract: Direct OpenAI gpt-6-luna roles and inherited v7.5/v7.6 active compact applicability/behavior contracts.
notes.consolidation: Success and failure strata are independent. The first trajectory in each non-empty stratum always generates. Gemini compares each later group of at most eight trajectories both with the current valid bank and with one another. One representative per proposed same-reason peer group generates; peers are rechecked against the actual generated rubric before reuse.
notes.generation_savings: A matched trajectory reuses the unchanged rubric and skips rubric generation and Gate. Matching is performed by the configured rubric-generator model; topic or label similarity alone is insufficient because all matcher checks must pass.
notes.unchanged: Agent, Doctor, Gate, scorer, prompts, rollout tree, reward, optimizer, schedule, cumulative scoring scope, and checkpoint behavior are inherited unchanged from train120_max4_direct_luna_v9_1.json. Rubric generation and both bank/peer consolidation matching use Gemini through OpenRouter.
notes.gate_runtime: Gate output limit is 16384 to prevent the observed direct-OpenAI length truncation; technical truncation remains an execution error, never a score.
notes.derived_from: configs/experiments/train120_max4_consolidation8_random5_idle622_v1.json at c765e74, flattened (one more extends level exceeds the loader depth limit of 8)
notes.transport: Identical to train120_max4_consolidation8_random5_idle622_v1.json except the judge transport: Gate, applicability / behavior scoring and intervention audit call the same GPT-6 Luna model through OpenRouter (openai/gpt-6-luna) instead of the direct OpenAI API (gpt-6-luna), because this host has no direct OpenAI credential. Prompts, token limits, structured-output schema, parsing, repair and retry logic are the unchanged LunaDecisionClient code path. Rubric generation and bank / peer consolidation matching stay on Gemini through OpenRouter as in the source config.
